description.value: Country Grocer Cedar is a full-service supermarket in the small rural community of Cedar on Vancouver Island, part of a family-owned, Vancouver Island chain that has been operating since 1984. The store emphasizes local sourcing from BC farmers and producers and offers a broad range of groceries alongside deli, bakery, sushi, and seafood platter services. It is a solid resupply point for cyclists touring the Cedar corridor south of Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Cedar location is fully accessible and confirms the store is active. Phone number (250) 722-7010 matches OSM. The OSM email (sgreen@countrygrocer.com) is outdated — the website lists Phil Ball (pball@countrygrocer.com) as current store manager. No bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; the site confirms this is a full-service grocery store with deli, bakery, sushi, and seafood platter services.
concerns: OSM email (sgreen@countrygrocer.com) appears outdated; website lists Phil Ball (pball@countrygrocer.com) as the current store manager.
Website address includes unit '#3C' (1824 Cedar Rd #3C) not present in the OSM record; updated address used in output.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible supermarket confirmed by a live website. A reliable grocery resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Cedar area.

wow_evidence: family-owned, Vancouver Island chain that has been operating since 1984
